about: Modwerk source-only mono-synth (SY MONO) package for Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74, compiled from sdk/analog-rytm-mkii/modules/mono-synth.

mods.title: Mono Synth
mods.summary: SY MONO: a digital mono voice with a saw, a pulse, a sub and noise, and a pitch LFO, through the track's analog filter and AMP.
mods.description: One band-limited oscillator with a saw and a pulse, a sub one or two octaves down and white noise, and a triangle LFO on pitch from 0.1 to 30 Hz, computed on the Rytm's ColdFire and sent through the voice's own analog filter, AMP and OVR. Offered on pads 1 to 8; a tap of encoder A steps the range (16', 8', 4', 2').
mods.author: chevyone
mods.on_unit: The same source ran on the author's Analog Rytm MKII on OS 1.74 in build SM04 (RAM-booted on a development base with a USB test link, 27 November 2026): the SYNTH page, six voices, the range tap, its cost and the voice stopping once its AMP closes. This package has not run on a unit.
